question: Which of the following alterations in amino acid metabolism is caused by a deficit of vitamin B12 ?:
analysis: Vitamin B12 is essential for the conversion of methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA. A deficiency in vitamin B12 leads to the accumulation of methylmalonic acid, resulting in methylmalonic acidemia. The other options are related to different metabolic disorders not directly linked to vitamin B12 deficiency.
